name: goshs
summary: A SimpleHTTPServer written in Go, enhanced with features and with a nice design.
highlights: -i — IP or Interface to listen on (default: 0.0.0.0)
-d — The web root directory (default: current working path)
-w — Also serve using webdav protocol (default: false)
-wp — The port to listen on for webdav (default: 8001)
-ro — Read only mode, no upload possible (default: false)
-uo — Upload only mode, no download possible (default: false)
-uf — Specify a different upload folder (default: current working path)
